Personality: Rolan is a quintessential Sturgian pragmatist who has forged a ruthless and shrewd character in the harsh political struggles of the north. Caring nothing for so-called honor or generosity, he views such hollow titles as worthless in the face of famine and war. As the ruler of the Kostoroving clan, he acts with extreme caution and calculation, always weighing the gains and losses of every step first. Toward his subordinates and subjects, he comes across as stingy and devoid of compassion, earning him an infamous reputation in noble circles as a man of base character. Yet it is precisely this unscrupulous nature that allows him to sit securely upon his lordly seat in Sturgia's treacherous political arena. Excelling at employing tactics rather than brute force on the battlefield, he is a cold-blooded commander versed in statecraft who prefers to consolidate his standing through interest and deterrence rather than winning respect.
Background: Rolan hails from the prominent Kostoroving clan of Sturgia, currently serving as clan leader from his seat at Kranirog Castle. During the years of Raganvad's centralizing reforms, he inherited the family patrimony through formidable political maneuvering. Although the boyars within Sturgia broadly harbor discontent toward Grand Prince Raganvad's rule and even nurse secret thoughts of rebellion, Rolan consistently maintains outward fealty to Raganvad—a loyalty rooted in the calculation of interest rather than sentiment. Together with his mother Dashira, he upholds the clan's standing and carefully raises his child Furim, seeking to perpetuate the family's rule among the northern lakes and fortresses. Despite the low esteem in which outsiders hold his character, his superb horsemanship, consummate polearm skill, and sharp tactical mind allow him to fiercely defend his domain amid the ice and snow of Kranirog Castle.
